jobs.description:
You'll join a close-knit team of approximately 15 colleagues where communication lines are short and everyone knows each other. In the workshop, you'll work closely with Hendrik, the experienced workshop manager, and a fellow technician. Hendrik has years of experience in the trade and enjoys sharing that knowledge with you. For a large organisation operating in a complex and highly regulated environment, we are looking for an experienced Senior Azure Cloud DBA Engineer.

The organisation is undergoing a major digital transformation, modernising traditional database platforms and expanding its capabilities within Microsoft Azure.

As a Senior Azure Cloud DBA Engineer, you will play a key role in designing, building, automating, securing and managing modern cloud-based database platforms.

You will be part of a specialised Database Administration & Engineering team, working closely with Cloud Architects, Platform Engineers, Infrastructure Architects, Cybersecurity teams, developers and operations teams.

 

You combine in-depth knowledge of SQL Server and Azure database technologies with expertise in automation, Infrastructure as Code, DevOps and cloud architecture.

A particular focus will be placed on the further implementation and governance of Cosmos DB, Azure SQL Database and automated database platforms.

Your responsibilities

1. Azure Database Platform Engineering

 
• Design, implement and manage enterprise-grade database platforms within Microsoft Azure.
  
 
• Develop and optimise Azure SQL Database and Cosmos DB services.
  
 
• Integrate database solutions into Azure Landing Zones.
  
 
• Design secure and scalable database architectures.
  
 
• Implement Private Endpoints, Private DNS and network security.
  
 
• Develop High Availability and Disaster Recovery solutions.
  
 
• Manage backup and recovery strategies.
  
 
• Contribute to further cloud adoption and platform modernisation.
  

2. Cosmos DB Engineering & NoSQL Governance

 
• Design, implement and manage Cosmos DB environments.
  
 
• Develop efficient NoSQL data models.
  
 
• Establish standards and governance principles for NoSQL databases.
  
 
• Optimise performance, capacity and cloud costs.
  
 
• Ensure security, documentation and metadata management.
  
 
• Bridge traditional relational database architectures with document-oriented solutions.
  

3. Database Administration & Data Security

 
• Design and automate data refresh processes for non-production environments.
  
 
• Implement data masking, scrambling and anonymisation techniques.
  
 
• Ensure GDPR-compliant processing of test and development data.
  
 
• Preserve business logic and referential integrity during data transformations.
  
 
• Develop consistent and reusable solutions for SQL Server, Azure SQL Database and Cosmos DB.
  

4. Infrastructure as Code & DevOps

 
• Develop and maintain reusable Terraform modules.
  
 
• Automate database deployments through Infrastructure as Code.
  
 
• Set up and maintain CI/CD pipelines.
  
 
• Develop PowerShell scripts and automation solutions.
  
 
• Work according to DevOps principles and best practices.
  
 
• Ensure consistent, secure and reproducible deployments across different environments.
  

5. SQL Server & Performance Engineering

 
• Act as a senior technical point of contact for SQL Server and Azure SQL.
  
 
• Analyse and resolve complex database performance issues.
  
 
• Perform root cause analyses.
  
 
• Optimise SQL queries and database configurations.
  
...

For this project, we are looking for a motivated  and experienced laboratory technician who combines solid lab skills with outstanding rigour, organisation and data-handling skills. You will work closely with the project’s postdoctoral researchers and consortium partners, running the assays that test whether our molecules make target proteins misfold during translation, and following up on hits in cells.
Responsibilities:

• Molecular biology: cloning, SDS-PAGE, western blotting, native PAGE
• Running, optimising and miniaturising assays (96/384-well), and supporting their transfer to our high-throughput screening partner
• Medium- to high-throughput screening of compounds and peptides, including plate design, controls, dose-response series and counter-screens
• Mammalian cell culture and cell-based hit validation: high-content imaging, degradation and dose-response assays
• Compound-protein binding studies (BLI, SPR, MST, fluorescence polarisation) 
• Compound and sample management: inventories, plate maps, sample tracking and shipments to partners
• Meticulous electronic lab notebook documentation, writing and maintaining SOPs, and structured, well-annotated data storage and analysis in line with the project’s data management plan
• Planning and tracking experiments against project milestones and deliverables, and contributing to the day-to-day running of the lab (ordering, stock management, equipment)
• Contributing to the interpretation of results, literature reviews and preparation of figures, methods sections and technical contributions to publications and reports.
• Acting as a technical reference point for project members, helping train new researchers and ensuring continuity of technical know-how across the consortium.

• A Bachelor in Biochemistry, Biotechnology, Biomedical Sciences or similar, or equivalent by experience
• Essential: Experience with core molecular biology and protein biochemistry techniques 
• Essential: Experience with mammalian cell culture and high-content imaging
• Essential: Experience with plate-based assays (luminescence/fluorescence), multichannel pipetting or liquid-handling automation to achieve high throughput
• Essential: Experience with electronic lab notebooks/LIMS, Excel and data analysis software
• Essential: Demonstrated ability to independently plan, execute and optimise experimental workflows and make technical decisions within agreed project objectives
• Essential: Fluent in English (oral and written); knowledge of Dutch is an asset
• Advantageous: Experience with in vitro translation, flow cytometry, protein purification or biophysical techniques
• Advantageous: Experience in training, mentoring or onboarding students or colleaguesCompetencies:
• Organisation and rigour: you work accurately and reproducibly, maintain excellent records and keep track of multiple experiments, samples, compounds and project deadlines. 
• Communication and teamwork: you communicate clearly and proactively, work effectively with colleagues and external partners, and are comfortable working both independently and within a multidisciplinary team. 
• Problem solving: you troubleshoot critically and propose practical solutions. 
• Discretion and motivation: you handle confidential and IP-sensitive information appropriately and have a genuine interest in drug discovery and translational science.
